thread:
emma.support: Customer NovaRetail (acct nova-221) reports sudden spikes in latency and EU egress despite app configured for us-east. They attached a sample request and logs. Can someone triage?

devin.eng: Share sample and any headers set?

emma.support: Here's the curl they sent:

```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions?region=false" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \n  -H "X-Client-Region: us-east-1" \n  -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```

They say ruby-sdk@0.6.2. Billing shows egress and latency from eu-west.

devin.eng: Checked trace for nova-221 at 2026-11-05T17:42:10Z:

```
[2026-11-05T17:42:10Z] req=nova-221 src=34.75.x.y query=region=false header:X-Client-Region=us-east-1 -> routed=eu-west-1 reason="query param present (literal 'false')"
```

devin.eng: Root cause: ruby-sdk serializes absent optional region to string "false" (Ruby false -> "false") and router treats any non-empty query param as authoritative. Account default region for nova-221 is eu-west, so requests go there. Header ignored due to query param precedence.

olivia.oncall: Impact: multiple customers on older SDKs may hit this if they don't set explicit region in header. Short-term mitigations:
- Support: instruct customer to remove/strip the region query param at their proxy
- Support: set X-Client-Region header to a recognized canonical value (e.g., "us-east-1") and we'll temporarily change router precedence to favor a valid header
- Encourage upgrade to ruby-sdk@1.0.0 which will stop serializing false to string

emma.support: Can you provide reproducible steps I can run quickly and share?

devin.eng: Repro steps:

```
# reproducer
curl -v "https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions?region=false" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "X-Client-Region: us-east-1" \n  -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'

# expected: routed to us-east; observed: routed to eu-west
```

devin.eng: PR to router: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/812 (ignore sentinel strings: "false","0","nil","null","undefined" and treat header as higher precedence when valid). Can canary to 5% in us-east tonight.

rachel.billing: We'll pull egress metrics for nova-221 (window 2026-11-05 17:30 -> 18:00 UTC) and estimate credits.

deploybot: canary scheduled: router v2.8.1-canary -> us-east (5% traffic) at 2026-11-06T02:00:00Z :rocket:

olivia.oncall: Owners: devin.eng (fix), olivia.oncall (rollout), emma.support (customer comms), rachel.billing (credits). ETA: canary tonight, full rollout in 12h if green.

emma.support: Thanks — I'll pass repro and proxy workaround to NovaRetail and keep them updated on the canary and billing.
